chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is'haq ibn Ammar who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the adulterer — how he should be flogged. He said: 'The most intense of the flogging.' I said, 'Over his clothes?' He said: 'Rather, he is stripped bare.'

key_terms.الزَّانِي: The person who commits zina (fornication or adultery) — the same root as the Quranic term in Surah Al-Nur
key_terms.الْجَلْد: Flogging/lashing — the prescribed hadd punishment for zina (100 lashes according to the Quran)
key_terms.يُجَرَّد: To be stripped bare — indicating the garments must be removed before the flogging is administered

ai.seo_question: How is the hadd punishment of flogging carried out for zina according to Imam al-Kazim?
ai.summary: Is'haq ibn Ammar asked Imam al-Kazim (peace be upon him) about the prescribed manner of flogging for the crime of fornication/adultery (zina). The Imam clarified two points: first, that the flogging must be administered with full severity (not softened), and second, that the garments must be removed so the punishment is applied directly to the skin. This ruling specifies the physical conditions for carrying out the hadd punishment of flogging as prescribed in Quran 24:2.
